[[File:Spiderclan_Stalker.jpg|thumb|220px|A Spiderclan Stalker]]
{{Quote|There is and can be only one clan of Nightsisters. This rogue clan that has taken up with the spiders... they are as great an annoyance as their pets.|[[Gethzerion]]|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''Spiderclan''' were a splinter group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] located in the [[Nightspider Cult cave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were known for keeping giant [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] as their slaves and were the archenemies of the benevolent witches of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]].

==History==
{{Quote|As if one clan of Nightsister were not trouble enough, now this rogue group has begun to gain power and influence.|[[Aujante K'lee]]|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] were a group of rogue [[Witches of Dathomir]] who chose to embrace the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] several centuries before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> Through time, internal divisions appeared amongst the Nightsisters, and several competing clans were born.<ref name="Infinity'sEnd">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref>

[[File:Beast_Attack_by_Urbach.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A Spiderclan member alongside a gaping spider]]
One of those new covens was the Spiderclan, whose members came to inhabit a cave close to the lands of their most hated foes, the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]. They lived there with large [[gaping spider]]s as companions. The enslaved creatures helped their mistresses with such things as daily chores and guarding the cave. The Sisters of the Spiderclan revered a giant spider they called the Queen Mother. The [[Mother (title)/Legends|Matron]] of the coven was considered the voice of the Queen Mother.<ref name="SWG" />

The witches of the Spiderclan were widely detested on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]&mdash;the Nightsisters considered them heretical abominations, and the benevolent covens saw them as a threat to be removed. Both sides had called outsiders for help in their crusade against the rogue Spiderclan sisters.<ref name="SWG" />
